title: The 3,000-Year-Old Sick Log
aria: Animated stick-figure short about a workmen's absence register from ancient Egypt, c. 1250 BC
foot: Space plays or pauses. Arrow keys step 1 s (Shift: 0.1 s). Narration is an AI voice (Kokoro, af_heart). Music and effects are synthesized for this video. Characters, poses and settings are illustrations; the ostracon is redrawn, not photographed. Facts: British Museum EA5634; University of Hamburg CSMC, Manuscript of the Month 54.
